query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' THEN 'has_phone' ELSE 'no_phone' END AS phone_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_r,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'transferred_contact' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_transferred,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'ghl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_ghl,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source NOT IN ('r', 'transferred_contact', 'ghl') OR source IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_other
FROM leads 
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) >= 365
  AND preferredChannel = 'Email'
  AND (opportunityStatus IS NULL OR opportunityStatus NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'abandoned'))
  AND humanTakeover = 0;
